title: Holiday Metric2 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holiday:metric2
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for holiday metric2 (2) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate holiday metric2 (2) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts how your holiday metric2 (2) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
